params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Intent:}} '''Yasuo's''' {{as|{{sti|'''total''' critical strike chance}}}} is doubled from all other sources. Additionally,{{ft|every {{as|1% critical strike chance}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{sti|{{as|{{fd|0.5}} '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.|every {{as|50% critical strike chance}} in excess of {{as|100%|critical strike chance}} is converted into {{sti|{{as|25 '''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.}}
params.description2: '''Yasuo's''' {{tip|critically strike|critical strikes}} deal only{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Yasuo|crit_base}}|100|mod={{ccd|Yasuo|crit_mod}}}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.|{{fd|{{#expr:{{ccd|Yasuo|crit_mod}}*100}}}}% of the {{sti|{{as|critical damage}}}} champions usually have.}}
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Resolve:}} '''Yasuo''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{tip|Flow}} for every {{pp|59 to 46 for 3|1 to 13}} units he travels by any means. At{{ft|100 stacks|{{pp|59*100 to 46*100 for 3|1 to 13}} units traveled}}and upon taking damage from an enemy {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}}, '''Yasuo''' consumes all {{tip|Flow}} to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{pp|125+((600-125)/17*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))) for 20}} that lasts for 1 second.
params.notes:
* '''Yasuo''' gains the shield before the damage instance; the shield will mitigate the damage that triggered it.
* '''Yasuo''' is able to reach {{as|100% critical strike chance}} with ''Way of the Wanderer's'' multiplier after obtaining a total of {{sti|{{as|50% critical strike chance}}}}.
* '''Yasuo's''' secondary resource bar will display the amount of shield stored as an equivalent percentage to his Flow stacks. (Each Flow stack will add {{pp|125/100+((600-125)/100/17*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))) for 20}} to the bar)
** Upon taking damage, the bar will display his current shield strength.
params.tips:
* Taking into account '''Yasuo's''' {{as|{{ccd|Yasuo|ms}} '''base''' movement speed}} and assuming he's constantly moving, it will take {{pp|59*100/{{ccd|Yasuo|ms}} to 46*100/{{ccd|Yasuo|ms}} for 3|1 to 13}} seconds to generate 100 {{tip|Flow}} stacks.
** Taking into account the {{as|45 '''bonus''' movement speed}} that most [[boots|Tier 2 boots]] grant (resulting in {{as|{{#expr:{{ccd|Yasuo|ms}}+45}} '''total''' movement speed}}), it will take {{pp|59*100/390 to 46*100/390 for 3|1 to 13}} seconds to generate 100 {{tip|Flow}} stacks.
<!--blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Intent:}} {{ci|Yasuo}} gains increased {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}. He also gains {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}} from excess {{as|{{sti|critical strike chance}}}}. However, his critical strikes deal reduced damage.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Resolve:}} '''Yasuo's''' movement generates the {{tip|Flow}} resource. He gains a brief {{tip|shield}} when taking damage from a {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|monster}} at maximum '''Flow''', consuming all of it.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yasuo''' thrusts his sword in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the first enemy hit. ''Steel Tempest's'' damage based on its {{as|AD ratio}} can {{tip|critically strike}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 105% AD)}}|Critical Strike Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Yasuo|crit_base}}*1.05|105|mod={{ccd|Yasuo|crit_mod}}}}|critical damage}} AD)|ad}}}}
params.description2: {{sbc|Steel Wind Rising:}} If this hits at least one enemy, '''Yasuo''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Gathering Storm'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 2 times and refreshing on subsequent hits. At 2 stacks, the next ''Steel Tempest'' cast consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
params.description3: {{sbc|Gathering Storm Bonus:}} '''Yasuo''' unleashes a whirlwind in the target direction that applies and triggers the same effects and additionally {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} enemies hit for {{fd|0.9}} seconds.
params.description4: ''Steel Tempest's'' thrust will fail to hit targets after the cast time if '''Yasuo''' was affected by {{tip|disarming crowd control}} during it, but the {{sti|cooldown}} of the ability is reset to {{fd|0.1}} seconds.
params.description5: If ''Steel Tempest'' is cast during ''{{ai|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}}'', the cast is modified to cause '''Yasuo''' to slash around himself at the end of the dash, applying and triggering the same effects against nearby enemies. This slash can be empowered by ''Gathering Storm's'' bonus, causing it to additionally apply the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} to enemies hit. ''Steel Tempest's'' cast time is not incurred when it is cast this way, but '''Yasuo''' will become {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the dash ends.

params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|215|Slash radius when used with Sweeping Blade}}
params.notes:
{{always quickcast}}
* Casting {{ai|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}} when ''Steel Tempest's'' remaining cooldown is less than {{fd|0.5}} seconds resets this remaining cooldown to allow casting it in combination, but adds the refunded time to ''Steel Tempest's'' cooldown.
* If '''Yasuo''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} during {{ai|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}} after having buffered ''Steel Tempest'' during it, he will perform the slash at the blink location, applying ''Steel Tempest's'' effects to enemies in the area at the time.
* If '''Yasuo''' becomes unable to cast abilities during {{ais|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}} dash after buffering ''Steel Tempest'', ''Steel Tempest'' will not cast, but will still go on cooldown.{{bug|2}}
* The whirlwind from consuming stacks of ''Gathering Storm'' can strike targets whose center is behind '''Yasuo''', unlike most {{tip|Projectile|missiles}}.
* ''Steel Tempest'' applies {{tip|basic damage}} to the first (closest) enemy hit and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary enemies:
** ''Steel Tempest'' will not apply {{tip|spell effects}} to the first target hit, but will do so to the secondary ones.
** {{tip|Spell vamp}} will only grant {{tip|heal|healing}} from the damage dealt to secondary targets, and healing is reduced to 33% effectiveness, accordingly.
** {{as|{{sti|Life steal}}}} will heal based on the damage dealt to the first target hit.
* If the first target hit by ''Steel Tempest'' is a {{tip|champion}}, {{ri|Hail of Blades}} will be triggered or refresh its buff duration.
* Once per {{tip|cast instance}}, upon hitting a {{tip|champion}}, ''Steel Tempest'' will consume a stack of {{ri|Hail of Blades}}.
* The whirlwind is a missile and can therefore be {{tip|projectile|intercepted}}.
* ''Steel Tempest'' will only draw minion aggro if the first target is a champion.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Steel Tempest'' maintains its casting angle direction in relation to '''Yasuo''' if he moves during the cast time.
* Each parry has different interactions with this ability, whether it's the first target of ''Steel Tempest'' or the secondary one. In either case '''Yasuo''' still gains a stack of ''Gathering Storm'' and his whirlwind knock-up cannot be negated by parries:
** {{tip|Dodge}}: both first target and secondary target '''do not''' take damage.
** {{tip|Block}}: first target '''does not''' take damage, secondary target '''does''' take damage.
** {{tip|Blind}}: both first target and secondary target '''do''' take damage.
* ''Steel Tempest'' rolls its {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} individually against each enemy hit.
* Casting {{ai|Last Breath|Yasuo}} during ''Steel Tempest'' will buffer it to cast after the cast time has completed.
** However, if {{ai|Last Breath|Yasuo}} is used on a target affected by an {{tip|airborne}} source that is not '''Yasuo''', it is cast immediately due to ''Steel Tempest's'' cast time ending prematurely. ''Steel Tempest'' will still cast in this case.
<!--14.11 fixed
* If ''Steel Tempest'' is buffered during ''Sweeping Blade'' and '''Yasuo''' uses {{si|Recall}}, {{si|Teleport}} or {{ii|Hextech Rocketbelt}}, ''Steel Tempest'' will go on cooldown without casting. In the case of {{ii|Hextech Rocketbelt}} '''Yasuo''' will also need to cast a movement command after it, else ''Steel Tempest'' will still trigger.
** If, after this effect, '''Yasuo''' inputs a basic attack command quickly followed by a movement command, he will cast ''Steel Tempest'' around him and basic attack the target at the same time.{{bug|1}}
*** ''Steel Tempest'' will not go on cooldown.-->
* {{tip|Spell shield}} does not prevent a stack of ''Gathering Storm'' from being gained.
* While at two stacks, a range indicator will be shown for the effective range of the whirlwind.
params.tips:
* Casting {{ai|R|Yasuo}} while buffering ''Steel Tempest'' during {{ai|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}} will also trigger the area of effect around '''Yasuo''' <u>after</u> the ''blink'', thus avoiding the ''Gathering Storm'' stack reset and generating a stack of ''Gathering Storm'' if the area of effect hits an enemy around where '''Yasuo''' blinked to.
* [[Emoting|Dancing]] (default {{sbc|CTRL+3}}) during ''Steel Tempest's'' cast time will hide the animation but not cancel the ability.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yasuo}} raises a wind wall that drifts in the target direction for a few seconds, blocking all enemy {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} that hit it.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yasuo''' raises a wall of wind in the target direction for 4 seconds that destroys all hostile non-{{tip|turret}} {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} that collide with it and grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings.
params.description2: The wall travels in the targeted direction over the first {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|Estimated}}, then drifts forward another 50 units over the remaining duration.
params.range: {{dv|{{tt|0 - 350|Windwall distance (final 50 units traveled only slowly)}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|450|Center of sight area}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Wind Wall'' grants {{tip|sight}} in a small static area in front of the cast location.
* ''Wind Wall'' starts blocking projectiles on-cast (despite not being fully formed).
* ''Wind Wall'' travels via a missile, and thus stops upon colliding with an enemy ''Wind Wall''.
* '''Yasuo''' can move during ''Wind Wall's'' cast time.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yasuo}} {{tip|blinks}} to the target {{tip|airborne}} enemy champion and instantly generates max {{tip|Flow}}. He then briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks up}}, {{tip|true sight|reveals}}, and deals {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby {{tip|airborne}} enemies.
params.blurb2: He becomes empowered for some time, causing his {{tip|critical strikes}} to gain {{sti|lethality|{{as|'''bonus'''-armor penetration}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yasuo''' {{tip|blinks}} to the {{tt|opposite side|Relative to Yasuo's cast location}} of a {{tip|sight|visible}} {{tip|airborne}} enemy champion {{tt|nearest to the cursor|searches in a 1100 radius}}, instantly generating maximum {{tip|Flow}} while resetting ''{{ai|Steel Tempest|Yasuo|Gathering Storm}}'' stacks.
params.description2: Upon arrival, he {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} all nearby {{tip|airborne}} enemy champions for 1 second, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} himself, and slashing them with his sword over the duration to deal {{as|physical damage}} thereafter. Surrounding enemy champions that become {{tip|airborne}} during this time will also be affected by ''Last Breath'' through the remaining duration.
params.description3: For the next 15 seconds, the damage dealt by '''Yasuo's''' {{tip|critical strikes}} ignores {{sti|lethality|{{as|60% of the target's '''bonus''' armor}}}}.
params.description4: ''A nearby {{tip|airborne}} enemy champion is required to cast this ability. If '''Yasuo''' would blink inside the {{sti|attack range}} of an enemy {{tip|turret}} (including the {{tip|Nexus Obelisk}}), Last Breath will instead attempt to position him outside of it.''
params.notes:
* ''Last Breath'' can be cast on targets {{tip|suspension|suspended}} in mid-air by {{cais|Aqua Prison|Nami}} {{tip|stun}}. 
** The wiki has adopted the term ''suspension'' for this unique property due to a statement by '''Yasuo's''' designer.<ref>[http://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1s0gkx/were_the_yasuo_team_ama/cdsp1op Yasuo Reddit AMA]</ref>
* The percentage {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} ignorance stacks additively with sources of {{as|percentage armor penetration}}.{{bug|2}}
* '''Yasuo''' gains the {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} ignorance on-cast.
* ''Last Breath'' requires the target to be affected by {{tip|airborne}} from an {{tt|enemy source|from the target's perspective}}, and simultaneously that the target is not considered {{tip|cc-immune}}, {{tip|displacement immune}}, or {{tip|untargetable}} during it.
** ''Last Breath'' cannot be cast if there are no nearby enemy champions that meet the conditions.
*** Attempting to cast the ability on an enemy champion that is not airborne will indicate that they "''Must Be Airborne!''".
*** {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent ''Last Breath'' from being cast and the target will be knocked up and dealt the damage.
**** The spell shield is still consumed in this case.{{bug|2}}
** Self-applied or allied-applied {{tip|airborne|displacements}} do not allow ''Last Breath'' to target the champion. Those applied by the ''neutral'' team (e.g. {{uis|Dragon}} initial knock back) '''can''' be targeted.
** An [[spell indicator|indicator]] will be placed towards enemy champions that meet the cast conditions within range of ''Last Breath'' to signify the ability can be cast.
** {{ai|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}} will prevent '''Yasuo''' from casting ''Last Breath'' on an airborne enemy champion far outside its borders.
*** '''Yasuo''' can only do so if the airborne enemy champion is positioned slightly outside of the borders.
* Upon ''Last Breath's'' cast, the targets' facing directions snap to '''Yasuo'''. Afterwards, their facing directions shift in all other directions every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the duration of the airborne.
** The last shift snaps them to the facing direction of the second one.
** On the {{csl|Yasuo|Nightbringer}} skin, these shifts in facing direction do not occur, but the targets' facing directions will still snap to '''Yasuo''' upon ''Last Breath's'' cast.
* '''Yasuo''' does not need {{tip|sight}} of {{tip|airborne}} enemy champions near his target to affect them with ''Last Breath''.
* ''Last Breath'' applies its damage and removes any forced movement{{bug|2}} on the targets when it ends, including if it is removed early by being {{tip|cleanse|cleansed}}.
** This is in contrast to most other effects with {{tip|airborne}}, which have their forced movement linger if the disabling debuff is removed and have to be overridden by another movement spell (such as {{cai|Relentless Pursuit|Lucian}} or {{si|Flash}}).
* Terrain displacing abilities (e.g. {{ai|Weaver's Wall|Taliyah}}, {{ai|Pillar of Ice|Trundle}}, {{ai|Volcanic Rupture|Ornn}}) that affect enemy champions are considered {{tip|airborne}}, and will therefore interact with ''Last Breath''.
* While ''blinking'', '''Yasuo''' creates an {{tip|untargetable}} ''clone'' of himself that cues a dashing animation (similar to {{ais|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}}) towards the target. This unit's rules do not follow those of a {{tip|clone|clone's}}. As such, it is more alike a champion, unless special cased.
* While performing ''Last Breath'', '''Yasuo''' is {{tip|lockout|locked out}} of performing actions.
** The lock out will end prematurely if all targets:
*** {{tip|Cleanse}} the {{tip|airborne|knock up}}.
*** Move far away from '''Yasuo'''.
*** Leave '''Yasuo's''' {{tip|sight}} (e.g. by {{tip|nearsight}}).
*** Become {{tip|untargetable}}.
*** {{tip|Death|Die}}.
*** Enter the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser}}.
